name: Apparix Backup
description: Full backup solution with Backblaze B2 cloud storage, tiered backup levels, AES-256 encrypted .env, health notifications, and size estimates. Free tier included.
author: Apparix

settings.label: Backup Tier
settings.description: Backup tier determines what is included. Higher tiers require higher license editions.

settings.label: Local Backup Retention
settings.description: Number of local backups to keep

settings.label: Enable Scheduled Backups
settings.description: Automatically create backups on a schedule (requires cron job)

settings.label: Backup Schedule
settings.description: How often to create automatic backups

settings.label: Enable Backblaze B2
settings.description: Enable cloud storage via Backblaze B2 S3-compatible API

settings.label: B2 Bucket Name
settings.description: Name of the B2 bucket for backups

settings.label: Auto-upload to B2
settings.description: Automatically upload backups to B2 after creation

settings.label: Cloud Retention
settings.description: Number of cloud backups to keep

settings.label: Stale Backup Warning
settings.description: Warn if no backup within this many days

features: Database backup with streaming export (low memory usage)
Product image and upload backup (Standard+ tier)
Health notifications and stale backup warnings
Size estimates per tier before creating backups
Free Backblaze B2 signup link in settings

2.0.0: Added Backblaze B2 cloud storage integration
Added tiered backup system (Essential, Standard, Complete)
Added health notifications (stale backup, disk space, B2 errors)
Added size estimates per backup tier
Added cloud backup management (upload, download, delete)
Added auto-upload to B2 after backup creation
Redesigned admin settings UI with tier cards and cloud panel
